fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CREDIT REFERENCE BUREAU CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ = 060002)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: PRODUCT/SERVICE TYPE
fields.description: Product/service type E.g. {Bank scan-Financial sector derived credit information, All sector scan- All sector derived credit information, Auto alert- Automated credit monitorig alert, Consumer Locate-skip trace on absconded borrowers, Comprehensive Business report-Corporate registry search, current operations, financials, references, Corporate registry report-corporate registry search only, Credit Application verification-financial & commercial credit application verification, Collateral Check-Reported details and liens on collaterals/securities, Staff check- employee credit history background check, etc}

fields.name: FEES AND CHARGES AMOUNT
fields.description: Amount of fees and other charges per product/service
